domains.summary: Company/tenant onboarding config spans three layers. (1) Company master record — org-service `company` table (Company entity) + `company_detail` (CRM/sales narrative) + `state_gst_detail` + `company.address` + `company_contact_map`, created/edited via iWork Add/Edit Company screens and the CreateCompanyDto (apps/services/org-service/src/app/company/dto/create-company.dto.ts, company-detail.dto.ts; entity at apps/services/service-lib/src/lib/entities/company.entity.ts). (2) Tenant/portal provisioning — config-service `company_portal_configuration` (ConfigCompany entity) holds subDomain, companyPortalUrl, company_database_id (FK to database_connect for multi-tenant DB), company logo, and an approval lifecycle (draft -> submit -> approved/rejected). Branding/dashboard/policy JSON lives in `company_portal_configuration_detail`. Auth methods per company live in `company_authentication_map` / `company_authentication_config`. Driven from iWork "Configure IBP Portal" page (apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/CompanyPage/PortalConfiguration/*) with URL/Domain, Login & Authentication, and Branding & Appearance sections, plus Policy Feature Document and Additional Documents tabs. (3) Subdomain-driven branding/content via Strapi `company-template` (GET /company-templates/subdomain/:subdomain) mapping subdomain -> companyId -> FAQs/footer/contactMatrix/disclaimers. Defaults (welcome message, password policy, auth methods) come from apps/services/config-service/src/app/auth-config/default-auth-config.provider.ts. The dynamic-datasource layer (apps/services/service-lib/src/lib/datasource/dynamic-datasource.service.ts) routes each tenant to MASTER/CENTRALIZED/CLIENT databases. NOTE: subdomain/portal-slug UI input is currently commented out (URLDomainSection shows preview only); the portal URL is derived from ENV.COMPANY_PORTAL_URL today. Detailed Login & Authentication / password-policy / OTP / dashboard / policy config fields belong to adjacent domains and are only summarized here.

domains.domain: Authentication & Authorization Configuration (iWork -> Portal Configuration -> Login & Authentication)
domains.summary: The IBP auth config is set per-company in iWork at Company Configuration -> Configure IBP Portal -> "Login & Authentication" (accordion #2). The UI is apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/CompanyPage/PortalConfiguration/LoginAuthSection/index.tsx, with field sub-controls in .../LoginAuthSection/loginMethods/* and all enums/defaults/labels in .../LoginAuthSection/constants.ts. Admins multi-select one or more login methods (5 method cards), then click "Configure" on each to open a per-method drawer; each method stores its own config (per-method config map, perMethodConfigs). The persisted backend schema + defaults live in apps/services/config-service/src/app/auth-config/default-auth-config.provider.ts, served via auth-config.controller.ts GET /auth-config/company?subdomain=... and persisted via PUT /auth-config/company/:companyId/methods/:authMethodId (companyPortalAuthConfig jsonb). Backend entities: apps/services/service-lib/src/lib/entities/authentication-method.entity.ts, company-authentication-config.entity.ts, company-authentication-mapping.entity.ts. The ibp employee/HR login consumes it via apps/ui/ibp/src/app/hooks/useAuthConfig.ts and useCompanyConfig.ts. NOTE: the entire surface is gated by feature flag FF_MULTI_AUTH (without it, only EMAIL_PASSWORD is offered) and FF_PASSWORD_RULES (password rule enforcement on login). Several runtime auth controls are environment variables (SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES, IWORK_SINGLE_SESSION, JWT_EXPIRATION) set per-deployment by DevOps, NOT per-company in the UI -- flagged below as DevOps-owned. The UI field validation bounds (e.g. password length 4-20) are helper-text/UI only; the backend stores raw JSON without a validation DTO. Method enum values: EMAIL_PASSWORD | PHONE_PASSWORD | USERNAME_PASSWORD | EMAIL_OTP | PHONE_OTP (+ GOOGLE_OAUTH / MICROSOFT_OAUTH defined but not exposed in the 5 selectable cards).

UI keys: email-password | phone-password | employee-id | email-otp | mobile-otp. Default: all 5 selected. Card labels: 'Email + Password', 'Email + OTP', 'Mobile + OTP', 'Phone Number + Password', 'Employee ID + Year of Birth'.

domains.domain: POLICY MASTER + POLICY-PORTAL configuration (iWork -> "Policy Details" / "Portal Configuration")
domains.summary:
Mapped the Policy master + Policy-level Portal Configuration surface from the actual TypeORM entities, NestJS DTOs and iWork React config files.

POLICY MASTER is the `policy` table — entity at apps/services/service-lib/src/lib/entities/policy.entity.ts (Policy class, ~80 columns). The fields a setup owner actually fills come from the create/update DTOs: apps/services/policy-service/src/app/policy/dto/policy.dto.ts (CreatePolicyDto/UpdatePolicyDto — policyName, policyTypeLid GMC/GPA/GTL, companyId, policyFrom, policyTo, provisionalPolicyNo, sumInsured, insurerPolicyNumber, nested policyTpas[] and policyInsurers[]) and update-policy.dto.ts (BasicDetailsDTO/PremiumAndBrokerageDetailsDTO/RconDetailsDTO). The iWork read-only render of these lives in apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/CompanyPage/PolicyDetails/detailsConfig.ts. Policy->Company link is the non-null policy.company_id FK (Policy lines 70-71, 739-741); policy is also tied to an opportunity (opportunity_id). Insurer/TPA linkage are join tables: policy-insurer-map.entity.ts and policy-tpa-map.entity.ts. Sum insured master value is policy.sum_insured (numeric 21,4); the per-grade/per-cover SI structure lives in policy_cover_map (Cover details tab — separate agent).

ENROLLMENT WINDOW (Enrollment Start Date / Enrollment End Date hard cut-off) is NOT on the policy row — it is stored per endorsement on the `endorsement` table: endorsement.entity.ts lines 85-97 (enrollment_start_date, enrollment_end_date), set at Inception (endorsement_type) and at each subsequent Endorsement. Per-employee override copy exists in policy-enrollment-employee-policy-map.entity.ts (lines 27-31). The Enrollment/Constraints tabs themselves are other agents' domains — noted only.

POLICY PORTAL CONFIGURATION (the per-policy "Portal Configuration" sub-tab) is defined in apps/ui/iwork/src/app/components/PortalConfigurationTab/config.ts — three active cards: Hospital Network upload, Policy Features document, Contact Matrix (FAQs card is commented out but the backend exists). Backing tables: mstr_policy_hospital_map (mstr-policy-hospital-map.entity.ts, isNetworkHospital Network/Excluded), policy_feature_document_map (policy-feature-document.entity.ts), policy_contact_metrics (policy-contact-metric.entity.ts), policy_faqs (policy-faq.entity.ts). DTOs in apps/services/policy-service/src/app/portal-configuration/dto/. Hospital upload template columns: HOSPITAL_TEMPLATE_HEADERS in apps/services/service-lib/src/lib/constants.ts lines 268-278.

NOTE: the company-level "Configure IBP Portal" page (Portal URL/Domain, Login & Authentication methods, Branding) at apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/CompanyPage/PortalConfiguration/ is company-scoped IBP setup and is flagged here but largely belongs to the company/IBP-portal agent.

domains.summary: The Constraints tab is fully data-driven. At runtime the iWork UI (apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/PolicyPage/PolicyConfigurator/PolicyConstraintsSection.tsx) renders one row per key found in the per-country master record returned by GET getConstraintsByPolicyId. That master lives in DB table mstr_policy_constraints (apps/services/policy-service/src/app/policy/scripts/mstr_policy_constraints.sql) as a JSONB blob keyed by country_id (one master row per country; the policy's company.country selects which set + defaults apply - see policy.repository.ts:10139-10179). Each JSONB entry carries questionLabel, defaultValue, uiType ("boolean"|"number"|"text"|"list"), optional options[], and an order int used only for row sorting (PolicyConstraintsSection.tsx:78-82). The canonical shape + the COMPLETE field list, defaults, labels and UI types are mirrored in the frontend constant POLICY_CONSTRAINTS_MASTER and the ConfiguredPolicyConstraints interface in apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/PolicyPage/PolicyConfigurator/policytypes.ts:343-529. There are 23 constraint fields total. UI rendering rules (PolicyConstraintsSection.tsx): boolean -> NO/YES switch; number -> 2-char numeric text box; text -> multiline; list -> switch (2 opts) / radio (3-4 opts) / dropdown (>4 opts). The values are persisted into policy_configuration.configuration.constraints and consumed at enrollment time by apps/ui/ibp .../EnrollmentFlow/utils/relationshipFilters.ts (parent/in-law/gender/cross-selection enforcement) and the age-extension logic there; the IBP enrollment ConstraintsConfig type (EnrollmentFlow/types.ts:43-56) confirms the same keys are read during enrollment. NOTE for setup sheet: EnrollmentVerificationModeOptions (SMS/EMAIL/BOTH/NONE, policytypes.ts:399-404) is defined but NOT wired to any constraint key - it is not part of the saved constraints today. Also lockEnrollmentAfterCutoff is force-disabled in the UI (rendered read-only, always its default) - flagged as a technical/UI behavior to confirm with Tech Lead.

domains.domain: Policy Configuration -> Enrollment Tab + Premium/Contribution Config (iWork -> Policy Configuration -> Enrollment)
domains.summary:
The enrollment configuration surface lives in TWO distinct, overlapping places, both backed by an opaque JSONB blob (the policy-service stores it as `policyConfiguration?: unknown` — see create-policy-configuration.dto.ts:57 and update-policy-configuration.dto.ts:60; there are NO typed entities in policy-service, all structure is defined UI-side and persisted as JSON).

1) The CANONICAL, exhaustive enrollment/premium constraint set is `POLICY_CONSTRAINTS_MASTER` in apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/PolicyPage/PolicyConfigurator/policytypes.ts:343-529 (the `ConfiguredPolicyConstraints` interface + master defaults/uiTypes). This drives the iWork PolicyPage -> Policy Configurator -> Constraints step (PolicyConstraintsSection.tsx). Note: this master is ALSO served from the backend via `endPoints.getConstraintsByPolicyId` (usePolicyConstraintsManager.ts:23-29), so the live option set/defaults are master-data-driven per country/policy and the UI hardcoded copy is a fallback.

2) A SECOND, simpler per-policy enrollment settings UI exists at apps/ui/iwork/src/app/pages/CompanyPage/PortalConfiguration/PolicyConfiguration/index.tsx (the PolicySettings interface, index.tsx:31-40) — this is the company-portal-level GMC/GTL/GPA toggle card surface, persisted as `companyPolicyConfig[]` (types.ts:220-231). It has a partly OVERLAPPING but SMALLER set of toggles than the constraints master (requireConfirmation, autoLockEnrollment, autoLockAfterConfirmation, employerContribution, disclaimerText, enrollment dates).

Premium/contribution split lives in the Components + Choices steps: per-SI-option company/employee contribution is `PolicyOptionChoice` (policytypes.ts:310-316), top-up/voluntary SI is the `sumInsuredModel` FLAT vs MULTIPLE toggle (PolicyComponent, policytypes.ts:131-146; PolicyComponentsSection.tsx:557-638), grade is a configurable Policy Parameter (PolicyParameterMaster 'Grade' range, policytypes.ts:84-88).

Runtime behavior is grounded in backend: cutoff-lock logic in service-lib enrollment-processing.util.ts:1799-1832,1872-1874; auto-submit-at-cutoff is a SYSTEM scheduler job (scheduler-service end-user-onboarding.scheduler.ts:45,397-424 -> ibp-service /company-employee/policy/auto-submit-after-cutoff), not a per-policy UI toggle. OTP identity verification at submission is the HR-on-behalf MultiEnrollment 'Enrolment Confirmation Verification' flow (ibp constants index.ts:357-385 VERIFY_IDENTITY + getVerificationOptions, VerifyLoginPage). The employee enrollment wizard (ibp EnrollmentSummary/index.tsx) consumes these settings: declaration checkboxes gate the Confirm Enrollment button (lines 110-160, 436-440).

KEY DISCREPANCY to flag: the two UIs disagree on defaults. Constraints master defaults enrollmentConfirmationRequired=true, autoLockEnrollmentAfterConfirmation=true, lockEnrollmentAfterCutoff=true (policytypes.ts:450-466). The PortalConfiguration card defaults requireConfirmation=false, autoLockEnrollment=true, autoLockAfterConfirmation=false (index.tsx:84-88). `EnrollmentVerificationModeOptions` (policytypes.ts:399-404, SMS/EMAIL/BOTH/NONE) is DEFINED but NOT wired into any constraint or UI — appears to be planned. lockEnrollmentAfterCutoff is rendered as a forced/disabled toggle in the Constraints UI (PolicyConstraintsSection.tsx:127-153). These are technical/config behaviors that should go through Tech Lead review before being treated as settable client options.

domains.domain: Strapi Content Management (Company Template + Policy Template)
domains.summary: The IBP content surface lives in the Strapi CMS microservice at apps/services/strapi-cms-service. Two collection types drive onboarding content: Company Template (keyed by companyId, one per company) and Policy Template (keyed by companyId + policyId, one per policy). Both use draftAndPublish (content must be Published to go live) and store all editable content inside a single non-repeatable `config` component. Content is authored in the Strapi admin panel (reached via the "Open Strapi" SSO button in iwork, gated by STRAPI_ADMIN_001 ACL permission). At policy activation, policy-service calls the template-initializer endpoint (apps/services/strapi-cms-service/src/api/template-initializer/controllers/template-initializer.ts) which CLONES the default templates (companyId "0" / policyId "0") for the new company/policy — so onboarding = clone defaults then edit per-client. The IBP employee/HR portal reads this content read-only via custom controller routes (GET /company-templates/company/:companyId, /company-templates/subdomain/:subdomain, /policy-templates/company/:companyId/policy/:policyId) into redux slices (apps/ui/ibp/src/app/redux/companyTemplateSlice.ts, policyTemplateSlice.ts) and renders it on Dashboard, ContactMatrix, FAQ, Support, and Enrollment/Policy pages. Key source files: company-template/policy-template content-types and the company-template/policy-template/terms-and-conditions component folders under src/components. Note: rich-text fields (FAQ answer, footer point, policyFeaturesDoc, T&C content, T&C introductionText) use the Jodit WYSIWYG custom field (plugin::jodit-editor.jodit); "acceptance mode" is modeled per disclaimer note via the boolean isMandatory (Mandatory when true, Optional when false), NOT a separate enum. A separate versioned Terms & Conditions collection type also exists (global, not per-company in schema) and is part of the content owners must author. The escalation-level component exists in schema but is orphaned (not wired into any content type); real escalation is modeled via contact-group primary/secondary contact persons.

domains.summary: The IBP integration surface is driven mostly by data-table configuration, not code constants. The hub of all third-party SSO (Good Health TPA e-card/claims/hospital, Alyve wellness, iConnect/Poppins analytics) is the single table `mstr_ext_application_ref`, read by document-service `POST /external-app-sso/magic-url`. Each row is one external app keyed by `label` (appKey) and carries a configurable 2-step API flow (auth URL/method/payload + data URL/method/payload), an `auth_type` (JWT | SESSION | DIRECT), and response-key extractors. Per-app secrets come from env vars `EXTERNAL_APP_JWT_SECRET_<LABEL>`. Key files: entity apps/services/service-lib/src/lib/entities/mstr-ext-application-ref.entity.ts; flow apps/services/document-service/src/app/external-app/external-app.service.ts; seeds database-migrations/sql/mstr-ext-application-ref.sql, database-migrations/sql/goodhealth-tpa-{ecard,claims,hospital-info}.sql, apps/services/document-service/src/app/external-app/alyve-wellness-seed.sql. The native Good Health TPA portal SSO (Quick Links -> TPA Login) is a separate AES-encrypted-querystring flow in ibp-service getEmployeeTpaPortalSsoUrl (env WEBACE_PORTAL_URL/WEBACE_SSO_KEY/WEBACE_SSO_IV). CRM-to-RiskWatch SSO uses auth-service generateCrmRedirectToken + per-company portal URL from `company_portal_configuration.company_portal_url` (entity config-company.entity.ts). Notifications run through notification-service `POST /notifications` keyed by `eventType` (NOTIFICATION_EVENT_TYPES in service-lib/constants.ts) over channels EMAIL (AWS SES, env EMAIL_FROM/SERVICE_EMAIL_FROM), SMS (SMSCountry, env SMSCOUNTRY_*), and IN_APP; per-company email overrides live in `company_email_template_map` (company-email-template-map.entity.ts). Policy-porting link and WhatsApp QR are hard-coded in the IBP UI (apps/ui/ibp/src/app/constants/index.ts and components/Header/index.tsx). connector-service is an empty NestJS stub (no integration logic). Per-company portal content (TPA/broker/HR contact matrix, FAQ, enrollment year range) lives in Strapi content-type company-template.
